summary: The Data Infrastructure Engineer designs, deploys, and maintains the core infrastructure that powers large-scale data platforms and pipelines.
responsibilities: Architect and maintain scalable and reliable data infrastructure
Manage distributed storage, compute clusters, and data lakes
Implement automation for infrastructure provisioning and monitoring
Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery
Collaborate with platform and data engineering teams

education: 4–8 years of experience in data infrastructure or cloud operations

skills_required.name: Experience with Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, and distributed storage
Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack)
